# Test fixtures

Hand-written answers of Apple's web catalog API, in its shape, for step 1e.
`page.html` stands for the web player's page; the tests serve the script
with a token they make.

`live/` holds answers Apple gave on 2026-11-04 for Radiohead's artist views
in storefront ru, with their next pages. Apple's editorial notes are cut
from them; shelf doesn't read them.
